set.body:
Observed 2026-10-18 on unmodified reframe4s origin/main e4667bc (Gale 779ed3d, image4s 1b6f1af):

1. reframe4s-halfflowJVM: 8 failures in BasinBridgeB5FollowUpSuite (jvm, lines 37/61) and BasinBridgeDecompositionSuite (shared, lines 168/253/276) — e.g. "native B4 lane captures the frozen 4.0/8.0/12.0 mm translation", "oracle B4 budget2x ... should retain a fine topology failure". JS shows 6 failures in BasinBridgeDecompositionSuite on the eco-u2-coordinates branch (same suites; baseline JS not separately run).
2. reframe4sTestRunners: benchmarks/flashalign/runner/.../halfflow/FunctionalQueryExportAudit.scala:81,108 references RealImageCheckpointJson, which does not exist (introduced by 2f9aeba) — 9 "Not found" errors.

Identical failure set on the eco-u2-coordinates branch (spatial4s pin wiring only); halfflow has no spatial4s edge. Possibly the Gale 779ed3d numeric changes moved the frozen basin oracles — check halfflow on the pre-Gale-bump revision before re-freezing anything; never loosen the oracle without a recorded scientific decision.
set.title: reframe4s main e4667bc is red: halfflow BasinBridge oracle tests fail and benchmark runners do not compile
